visualCharacteristics.purpose: side-by-side columns, each a small heading over an inline row of logo or icon links
traits: two columns at desktop, stacked on mobile
small heading above each logo row
small, uniformly sized logos in a wrapping row

contentPattern.structure: One row, one cell per column (more rows add more columns). Each cell: heading, then linked logo images or :icon: tokens. Image alt text names each logo; icon-only links are named from the icon name. Plain text links are kept as text items

usage: Payment options and social links above the footer; good candidate for a shared fragment.
reuseGuidance: Use for any logo strip grouped under headings. For content columns use the vanilla columns block.
